purpose: Domain map for Robin's engineering and science reasoning layer.
reasoning_policy: Use equations and dimensional analysis for quantitative questions.
Show assumptions when a result depends on missing parameters.
Use calculator tools for arithmetic instead of mental estimation when practical.
Distinguish educational guidance from professional engineering, electrical, or chemical safety advice.
For hazardous procedures, prefer safety information and conservative limits over procedural optimization.
reference_policy: Prefer authoritative, current, openly licensed or permission-cleared sources. Do not ingest copyrighted textbooks into model training without permission.
